assignment: Enumerate every live Object(NonMatching, ...) registration, inspect every freshly generated aggregate fuzzy_match_percent 100.0 candidate, and reclaim only candidates that satisfy exact section, instruction, relocation, link, and DOL gates; match no new functions

method.registration_parser: Python AST over live Object calls whose first positional argument is the NonMatching name and whose second positional argument is a constant string; this includes multiline registrations and excludes comments
method.score_source: build/GEDE01/report.json freshly regenerated by objdiff-cli v3.6.1
method.join_key: configure.py object path to objdiff unit metadata.source_path after removing the src/ prefix
method.candidate_prefilter: registered NonMatching unit with aggregate fuzzy_match_percent exactly 100.0
method.reclaim_gate: Fresh one-shot objdiff must prove exact generated and retail section ownership and size plus 100% instruction and relocation agreement; the full canonical link and retail DOL SHA-1 gate must remain exact
method.zero_code_rule: A data-only unit cannot qualify through aggregate code measures because its 100% code score is vacuous; its data sections must independently pass the exact section gate
method.prior_art_check: fn_80109EEC had already been examined in objdiff-fn_80109EEC-session-1183-remediation-2.json, objdiff-fn_80109EEC-session-1183-remediation-3.json, reclaim-session-1210-game_fn_80109EEC.json, and objdiff-consolidation-game_fn_80109EEC-session-1250.json before session 1290. The initial session-1290 diff reproduced that prior relocation defect and was not new evidence; only post-remedy verification is retained for session 1290. The consuming TU did not change during remediation 2, and a fresh rerun was byte-identical to remediation-1 at SHA-256 6d4d1dab742ffe6e7cb3b2934ec0fae82e54180143d8de6e709c83b929f5bcc1, so the canonical remediation-1 report is referenced instead of retaining a duplicate copy.

matched_byte_accounting.note: fn_80109EEC was reclaimed without advancing the frontier. Aggregate matched_code was already 180/180 before the fix, but exact linked complete_code increased by 180 bytes after the relocation target was corrected.

candidates.reason_not_reclaimed: Section ownership and size differ, so the aggregate 100.0 is a vacuous-code false positive.

pre_remediation_exact_gate.generated_extra_section_contents: ASCII ed_ai_Projectile followed by 16 zero bytes
pre_remediation_exact_gate.retail_symbol_contents: Four populated rows of signed 16-bit coordinates: 0126 002B 0078 0020 / 00D9 003E 0048 0020 / 01A4 003E 0056 0020 / 0124 0057 0079 0020
pre_remediation_exact_gate.semantic_data_defect: The old TU-local 32-byte initializer was not retail data: it contained only the 16-byte ASCII string ed_ai_Projectile and 16 trailing zero bytes. Retail lbl_8023A278 is a fully populated 4x4 signed-16 coordinate table that fn_80109EEC indexes at runtime.
pre_remediation_exact_gate.relocation_defect: Retail HA/LO relocations target lbl_8023A278; generated HA/LO relocations targeted TU-local symbol @4. All 45 instruction encodings were otherwise identical, but the relocation target and the referenced 32-byte data were both wrong.

candidates.remedy: Replace the wrong TU-local string initializer with the separately defined retail 4x4 coordinate table and initialize the stack copy from lbl_8023A278. Declare and define the symbol consistently as CoordinateTable; explicit .rodata placement preserves retail section ownership because const-qualifying the aggregate changes MWCC's consumer scheduling.
candidates.reason_reclaimed: The corrected numeric-table copy reproduces the retail stack-copy code, runtime data, and exact lbl_8023A278 relocation targets, so both affected objects pass section, data, instruction, relocation, link, and DOL gates.

progress_metric_defect.observed: Before remediation, objdiff report generate recorded fuzzy_match_percent 100.0, matched_code 180/180, and matched_functions 1/1 for fn_80109EEC while objdiff-cli diff scored 98.888885% because only HA/LO relocation targets differed.
progress_metric_defect.impact: The aggregate report path does not expose relocation-target-only divergence and therefore manufactured a false exact-match premise for this consolidation assignment.
progress_metric_defect.mitigation: Require focused objdiff diff evidence with zero instruction and relocation diff nodes before reclaiming any unit. Linked Matching units are additionally backstopped by the canonical DOL SHA-1 gate; residual exposure is limited to unlinked units that are not covered by that link gate.
